title:
There are 2 hard problems in CS:
1. Cache Invalidation
2. Naming Things
3. 404s on Cached Pages
subtitle: The page was fixed in the database 4 hours ago, but our edge CDN cached the 404 response with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` across 320 points of presence.
logs: > database query returned: Record exists (Status: Published).
> sending cache purge request across global CDN...
> developer trying to append `?cache_bust=12345` to URL...
> edge rules stripped query parameters for optimization.
> page remains permanently 404 across Europe and Asia.
footnote: Error code: `IMMUTABLE-CACHE-404` · Edge nodes affected: 320 · TTL: Until heat death of universe
pathTemplate: `{path}` actually exists, but Cloudflare cached our mistake for the next 12 months.
